summary: Iteration 4 tested the workload tracker, the 6-area injury scanner and the full AI coaching session, on both backend and frontend. New pytest file (11 tests): all pass. That covers workload shape and validation (400/422), owner-only delete, the ACWR >1.5 high flag, the streak flag, the Under-16 guide flag, /speak + /tts, and a full session: plan with all blocks, one bowling ball and one test ball each stored with their block, +1 workload per ball (source=session), and end returning achievements and test_result. POST /analyses returns all 5 AI areas plus the server-computed workload area. Regression suite: 39 of 40 tests passed; the one failure was a stale 'PaceSensei' root assertion, which I fixed. Frontend at 390x844: all requested flows pass. Home workload card opens /workload. The workload screen shows status, stats, gauge and chart; logging (day, +/-, intensity) and deleting entries update the numbers. A non-Pro device sees workload-locked. On the report screen the injury scanner shows all 6 rows, which expand and collapse. The full /session flow works: warm-up (items, timer counts down) -> drills -> bowling upload via web file chooser -> test block -> cool-down -> summary with test result, achievements and tips. Ending early with no balls also works. Profile age band chips save and persist. Two real bugs found: workload dates are not normalised, and the 'today' date can differ between client and server. No deprecated Expo packages (uses expo-audio / expo-video).

minor.issue: date is checked with date.fromisoformat but the raw string is stored. Python 3.11 accepts compact ISO ('20261116'), so it is stored as-is and never matches day(i) keys. It is silently left out of acute/chronic/weeks. Reproduced: posted 50 balls with date 20261116 -> acute 0. Fix: store date.fromisoformat(body.date).isoformat().
Future dates are accepted (2099-01-01 stored, never counted). Reject dates more than about 1 day in the future, and probably older than about 56 days.

Timezone mismatch. The client sends the local date (iso(new Date())), but the server uses date.today() (container UTC) for 'today', the acute window and session-ball dates. For users ahead of UTC, an entry logged as 'Today' can be counted as a future day and missed from acute until the server date rolls over. Session balls can also land on a different day than manual entries. Suggest the client sends tz offset or a local 'today' (e.g. a header) and the server uses it.
Not Pro-gated on the server; only the client gates it. Low priority if that is intended.
age_band is a free string, not checked against the WEEKLY_GUIDE keys. An invalid value just disables the guide flag. Use a Literal or enum.

ui_bugs.issue: Delete entry has no try/catch or error state. A failed DELETE is an unhandled promise rejection with no feedback.

Uses router.back() with no canGoBack fallback. When /profile is opened directly (deep link or web refresh), Save succeeds but the screen does not move. Use the same pattern as the other screens: canGoBack ? back : replace('/').

integration_issues.issue: When a session ends, only ['sessions'] is invalidated. ['workload'] (and progress) are not, even though each ball adds workload. It currently refetches on mount, so the impact is low. Invalidate ['workload'] in end() and after each ball.

issues: plan-timer-* pills are 36px high (below the 44px touch target).
plan-item-* checkbox is 28x28 with hitSlop 8 (44 effective, OK).
Weekly chart labels show only the day number ('22', '29', '06'...). Without a month the weeks read ambiguously; consider 'dd MMM' or 'W-1' labels.

action_items: Normalise the workload date on the server (store date.fromisoformat(d).isoformat()) and reject future dates.
Fix the client/server 'today' mismatch: pass the client's local date or tz offset and use it in workload_summary and add_balls.
Add try/catch + an error banner to the workload entry delete.
Profile save: fall back to router.replace('/') when it cannot go back.
Invalidate the ['workload'] query after session balls and session end.
Optional: validate age_band against the allowed values; increase plan-timer height to 44.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 970 lines (>700). Split the workload, sessions and analysis routers into modules.
PlanStage advance(): two quick advances can let an older /speak response replace the newer message's audio (setMessage({text, audio}) with stale text). Guard with a ref to the current stage.
start_session: if the LLM returns a plan missing keys, the frontend falls back (plan.test?.name ?? ...), but there is no server-side schema validation of the plan.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 new; 40/40 regression after the stale assertion fix)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 2 low-priority UI bugs

rca_of_issue: Workload date bug: log_workload validates with fromisoformat but stores body.date unchanged. workload_summary looks keys up via (today - i).isoformat(), so non-canonical strings never match.
